I know in my heart that my Great Great Grandparents and my Great Grandparents along with my Grandparents, all resided in Cornwall at the time of the Parade. This is amazing to catch a glimpse of their life style. I know that some of them were at that parade, I only wish I knew who was who. I absolutely love this opportunity.
A Remarkable documentation of folks being...just folks

Most pictures, moving or not, from the past show people very much aware that they are being captured on film or in paint. The importance they attached to the event, and their sense of occasion, is frequently (mis)read as stiffness or lack of joy. Here's a rare chance to see people--admittedly on a special day--just being themselves. The particularities of the location and the day have been described elsewhere. I agree with what another reviewer has noted: there are so many people marching in this small town, one wonders who was left to do the watching? But that very issue points up one of the…
